Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.event

Class QueryExecuted

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.event.QueryExecuted
public final class QueryExecuted extends Object
Describes a statement that ran successfully.

Instances are immutable and safe to share between threads, provided the binding values themselves are not changed.

    • QueryExecuted

      @Internal public QueryExecuted(String connectionName, QueryKind kind, String sql, List<?> bindings, Duration time, int transactionLevel)
      Creates an event; the binding list and every byte[] in it are copied.
      Parameters:
      connectionName - the connection's name, never null
      kind - the kind of statement, never null
      sql - the SQL, never null
      bindings - the binding values, never null
      time - how long the statement took, never null
      transactionLevel - the transaction depth, 0 outside a transaction

    • time

      public Duration time()
      Returns how long the statement took.
      Returns:
      the time, never null and never negative
      API Note:
      A cursor reports the time to open it, not to read it. A pretended statement reports Duration.ZERO.

    • transactionLevel

      public int transactionLevel()
      Returns the transaction nesting level the statement ran at.
      Returns:
      the level, where 0 means outside any transaction

    • redacted

      public QueryExecuted redacted()
      Returns a copy whose binding values are replaced by "?".
      Returns:
      a new event with the same fields and one "?" per binding, never null
      API Note:
      Pass this to code that must not see personal data or secrets.
